raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.3.34"
  build_number: 2
  next_version: "0.3.35"

recipe:
  name: openblas-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/OpenMathLib/OpenBLAS/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: cd7e129868320cc2d033afa920e31202dfe0b8066a5b66661900ccc0f197dfed
  patches:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      # don't run test_fork in emulation, it has a tendency to hang indefinitely
      then: patches/0001-don-t-run-test_fork-in-cross-compilation.patch
    - if: win and arm64
      # Included upstream immediately after the 0.3.34 release.
      then: patches/0002-fix-array-pointer-argument-mismatch-on-WoA.patch
    - if: win and arm64
      # Avoid invoking GCC-only -dumpversion when CMake selected clang-cl.
      then: patches/0003-fix-cmake-compiler-version-check.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  variant:
    use_keys:
      - INTERFACE64

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: openblas-build
    build:
      script:
        file: build
        env:
          INTERFACE64: ${{ INTERFACE64 }}
          SYMBOLSUFFIX: ${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}
          USE_OPENMP: ${{ USE_OPENMP }}
          PKG_VERSION: ${{ version }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
        - if: win and arm64
          then: m2-perl
          else: perl
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - if: win
          then:
            - cmake
            - ninja
        - if: osx
          then: objconv
        - if: USE_OPENMP == "1"
          then: llvm-openmp
        # Following is needed because the Fortran compiler add an rpath to the BUILD_PREFIX
        - if: linux and USE_OPENMP == "1"
          then: _openmp_mutex * *_llvm
      host:
        - if: win and USE_OPENMP == "1"
          then: llvm-openmp-fortran

  - package:
      name: libopenblas${{ name_suffix }}
    inherit:
      from: openblas-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      string: ${{ "openmp" if USE_OPENMP == "1" else "pthreads" }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      variant:
        use_keys:
          - INTERFACE64
        # On macOS, OpenMP was the original threading model,
        # while on Windows and Linux, pthreads was the original threading model
        down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 1 if (not osx and USE_OPENMP == "1") or (osx and USE_OPENMP == "0") else 0 }}
      files:
        # Include files like
        #   - libopenblasp-r0.3.5.so
        #   - libopenblas_vortexp-r0.3.5.so
        #   - libopenblas.so.0
        # Avoid files
        #   - libopenblas.so
        - if: unix
          then: lib/libopenblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}*p*.${{ "dylib" if osx else "so" }}
        - if: linux
          then: lib/libopenblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}.so.*
        - if: osx
          then: lib/libopenblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}.*.dylib
        - if: win
          then: Library/bin/openblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}.dll
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
        - if: USE_OPENMP == "1"
          then: llvm-openmp
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libopenblas" ~ name_suffix) }}
      run_constraints:
        - openblas${{ name_suffix }} >=${{ version }},<${{ next_version }}.0a0
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - if: linux
              then:
                - lib/libopenblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}p-r${{ version }}.so
                - lib/libopenblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}.so.0
            - if: osx
              then:
                - lib/libopenblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}p-r${{ version }}.dylib
                - lib/libopenblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}.0.dylib
            - if: win
              then: Library/bin/openblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}.dll
      - if: unix
        then:
          files:
            recipe:
              - test_openblas.c
          requirements:
            build:
              - binutils
              - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
              - ${{ compiler('c') }}
          script:
            - $CC test_openblas.c ${{ "-Dopenblas_get_config=openblas_get_config64_" if SYMBOLSUFFIX == "64_" else "" }} -L$PREFIX/lib -Wl,-rpath,$PREFIX/lib -lopenblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}p-r${{ version }} -o test_openblas
            - if: build_platform == target_platform
              then: ./test_openblas
            - if: osx
              then: nm -g ${PREFIX}/lib/libopenblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}p-r${{ version }}.dylib | grep dsecnd
    about:
      homepage: http://www.openblas.net/
      repository: https://github.com/OpenMathLib/OpenBLAS
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file:
        - LICENSE
        - lapack-netlib/LICENSE
      summary: ${{ "An optimized BLAS library (ILP64 interface) based on GotoBLAS2 1.13 BSD version" if SYMBOLSUFFIX == "64_" else "An optimized BLAS library based on GotoBLAS2 1.13 BSD version" }} 

  - package:
      name: openblas${{ name_suffix }}
    inherit:
      from: openblas-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      string: ${{ "openmp" if USE_OPENMP == "1" else "pthreads" }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      variant:
        use_keys:
          - INTERFACE64
        down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 1 if (not osx and USE_OPENMP == "1") or (osx and USE_OPENMP == "0") else 0 }}
      files:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - include/*.h
            - lib/libopenblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}*.a
            - lib/libopenblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}.${{ "dylib" if osx else "so" }}
            - lib/pkgconfig/openblas${{ "64" if SYMBOLSUFFIX == "64_" else "" }}.pc
            - lib/cmake/openblas/*
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/include/openblas
            - Library/lib/openblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}.lib
            - Library/lib/pkgconfig/openblas.pc
            - Library/share/cmake/OpenBLAS
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libopenblas" ~ name_suffix, exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - if: unix
              then:
                - cblas.h
                - lapacke.h
                - openblas_config.h
          files:
            - if: unix
              then:
                - lib/libopenblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}.a
                - lib/libopenblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}.${{ "dylib" if osx else "so" }}
                - lib/pkgconfig/openblas${{ "64" if SYMBOLSUFFIX == "64_" else "" }}.pc
            - if: win
              then:
                - Library/include/openblas/cblas.h
                - Library/include/openblas/lapacke.h
                - Library/include/openblas/openblas_config.h
                - Library/lib/openblas${{ SYMBOLSUFFIX }}.lib
                - Library/lib/pkgconfig/openblas.pc
    about:
      homepage: http://www.openblas.net/
      repository: https://github.com/OpenMathLib/OpenBLAS
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file:
        - LICENSE
        - lapack-netlib/LICENSE
      summary: ${{ "An optimized BLAS library (ILP64 interface) based on GotoBLAS2 1.13 BSD version" if SYMBOLSUFFIX == "64_" else "An optimized BLAS library based on GotoBLAS2 1.13 BSD version" }}

about:
  homepage: http://www.openblas.net/
  repository: https://github.com/OpenMathLib/OpenBLAS
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - lapack-netlib/LICENSE
  summary: An optimized BLAS library based on GotoBLAS2 1.13 BSD version

  recipe-maintainers:
    - gillins
    - groutr

    - h-vetinari
